description: Turn the locked master prompt into tasks (usually the lead's job) or add tasks later. Contracts first: the first task is always the skeleton (repo setup, shared types and API contracts, database schema, lint/format config) and the other tasks depend on it. Give every task its own folder area and explicit dependencies. create: save a plan (replace=true drops tasks nobody started). add: append tasks. list: show the board.

replace.description: create only: remove tasks that nobody has started.

acceptance.description: How to check it is done.

assignee.description: Teammate's name to assign or propose (depends on the team's assign mode).

depends_on.description: Keys of tasks that must be done first.

description.description: What to build, in a few sentences.

key.description: Optional short key like T1. Assigned automatically when omitted.

name: plan
